title: Three.js: beginner
units/0/blurb: What Three.js is; scene, camera, renderer and Mesh; the animation loop and window resizing.
units/1/blurb: PerspectiveCamera: fov, aspect, near and far; z-fighting, lookAt and OrbitControls; OrthographicCamera.
units/2/blurb: position, rotation in radians and scale; axes; hierarchy with Group, local and world coordinates.
units/3/blurb: Basic, Lambert and Standard; light sources and their falloff; the four shadow flags.
units/4/blurb: TextureLoader, sRGB and repeating, loading glTF, centering and scaling a model, dispose. The course final.
